title: Understanding Recall and Accuracy
text: Recall is the ratio of true positives to the sum of true positives and false negatives. Accuracy is the ratio of correctly predicted instances to the total instances.

title: Calculating True Positives and False Negatives
text: To calculate recall, identify the true positives (correctly predicted 1s) and false negatives (actual 1s predicted as 0s).

title: Threshold Impact on Predictions
text: Changing the threshold affects which predicted probabilities are classified as $$1$$. A lower threshold increases recall but may decrease accuracy.

title: Calculate Recall for Threshold $$0.7$$
text: For a threshold of $$0.7$$, calculate the recall. How many true positives and false negatives are there?

title: Calculate Accuracy for Threshold $$0.7$$
text: For a threshold of $$0.7$$, calculate the accuracy. How many predictions are correct out of the total?

title: Determine Threshold Range
text: What is the range of thresholds that maintains an accuracy above $$0.75$$ while maximizing recall?
